permitSignatureFormsEquivalent.detail: The packed 65-byte signature is pinned in CVL byte by byte (signature[i] == byte i of r/s, signature[64] == v). The prover's model of a CVL `bytes` value is a map from byte offset to 32-byte word that is not kept coherent across offsets: the word the contract mloads at offset 0x20 (s) is not tied to the bytes constrained at indices 32..63 (run 53186bb4: sWord = 0xd, byte 63 = 0x0d, yet the word read at 0x20 = 0xc). The bytes form therefore decodes a different s, ecrecover misses owner, the NONDET ERC-1271 fallback fails and only that call reverts. Not a contract behaviour; same result with precise_bitwise_ops. Covered soundly by permitVrsDecodesPackedSignature + permitSignatureFormsSameEffects.
